info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description: Overview of the event industry including conventions, expositions, and major national and international events and their operational requirements.
info.studentTasks:
- Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

materials.materialDescription: Successful Event Management: A Practical Handbook
materials.author: Anton Shone, Bryn Pary

clos.loDetails: Identify the key characteristics of events, events industry bodies, in order to understand the business of events management as a service activity
Understand the scope and scale of the events business and the determinants of demand for events
Identify the social, economic, political impact and developmental implications of running events
Understand the planning process for events, including the budgetary organization of events, marketing, catering and technical provisions.
Identify issues of risk management in terms of event planning, operations and the issues involved in closing down an event
Intergrate a theoratical framework in to an event project
